entries.name: Android
entries.summary: Capacitor Android shell. Production consumes out/ as webDir and adds Android-native plugins, policies, resources, signing and store artifacts.
tags: capacitor android shell. production consumes out/ as webdir and adds android-native plugins, policies, resources, signing and store artifacts.

entries.name: Development
entries.summary: Next.js development runtime on port 3001; Capacitor can optionally live-reload from it through CAPACITOR_SERVER_URL.
tags: next.js development runtime on port 3001; capacitor can optionally live-reload from it through capacitor_server_url.

entries.name: iOS
entries.summary: Capacitor iOS shell. Production consumes out/ as webDir and adds iOS-native plugins, entitlements, signing, archive and TestFlight/App Store behavior.
tags: capacitor ios shell. production consumes out/ as webdir and adds ios-native plugins, entitlements, signing, archive and testflight/app store behavior.

entries.name: Independent services
entries.summary: Separately deployed service runtimes under services/*; they are not exercised by the root next start process.
tags: separately deployed service runtimes under services/*; they are not exercised by the root next start process.

entries.name: Static out
entries.summary: Static Next.js export in out/. It has no bundled src/app/api handlers and must use a remote API base URL; it is the web payload copied into native shells.
tags: static next.js export in out/. it has no bundled src/app/api handlers and must use a remote api base url; it is the web payload copied into native shells.

entries.name: Tooling
entries.summary: Repository scripts, generators, validation, deployment orchestration and release tooling executed by Node/npm.
tags: repository scripts, generators, validation, deployment orchestration and release tooling executed by node/npm.

entries.name: Web
entries.summary: Server-capable Next.js web application. Production builds produce .next and deployment may run on Vercel/serverless infrastructure.
tags: server-capable next.js web application. production builds produce .next and deployment may run on vercel/serverless infrastructure.
